environment: Disposable loopback QA fixture, isolated from deployment messaging credentials
regressions_fixed: First-party signed file redirects now preserve the requesting origin; external provider URLs retain their signatures.
Attachment preview ignores completed requests after a selection changes or unmounts and releases its object URLs.
Rapid task-filter changes compose instead of losing earlier query updates.
Task actions wait for query refresh so embedded/full-page discussions reflect reactions and resolution immediately.
Clipboard permission prompts are bounded so export cannot remain busy indefinitely.
browser_evidence: Attachment Preview, Open and actual downloaded bytes verified against the original failing task.
Text, image decode and rendered PDF previews verified with disposable files.
CSV, XLSX and PDF exports downloaded; clipboard export completed and re-enabled Export.
Task creation, inline editing and persistence, grouping, filters, pagination, bulk updates, checklist/subtasks/comments and timer save verified.
scope_limits: Route and layout checks cover all 192 static CRM/PMS routes, including aliases. Dynamic records were sampled through the recorded workflow scenarios.
112 interaction scenarios exercise shared control implementations; the inventory does not claim execution of every individual record button or every possible input combination.
Live provider sends, OAuth/security grants, financial transactions, permanent deletions and destructive administration actions were not executed.
